summary: REGENXBIO Inc. filed an 8-K (Items 8.01 and 9.01) on June 29, 2026, reporting that it earned a $100 million milestone payment from AbbVie for dosing the first patient in a Phase IIb/III trial of surabgene lomparvovec in diabetic retinopathy. No securities offering, merger, acquisition, or activist event is disclosed. The filing is a routine business update on a collaboration milestone, not a special situation. It is categorized as None.
